title: ACL Phase 1
author: Theo L.
desc:
Goal: Restore range of motion (ROM), activate stabilizing muscles (glutes, hamstrings, quads, foot muscles), and improve balance.			
Weekly Schedule (4x per week minimum)

ex.note: Flex and extend knee, assist with towel if needed

Squeeze quad, push knee down into floor
Hold 5 seconds
Focus on full extension, control
Lift arch without curling toes
Lift big toe, keep others down & vice versa

12 per side 
Keep hips stacked, engage glutes
Squeeze glutes at top, no arch in lower back

12 per side 
Keep toes pointed forward
Progress to eyes closed
Flex and extend knee, assist with towel if needed
